environment:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production TRANSPARENT environment sprite atlas for CodeMap RPG.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the user's warm painterly fantasy valley screenshot. Create a NEW matching modular art pack, no copied UI or characters. Rich hand-painted storybook HD-2D game style, charming forms, detailed brush textures, golden sunlight from upper LEFT, cool teal shadows, lush green foliage with yellow lit leaf tips. Elevated front three-quarter RPG camera (not a diamond isometric grid).
Exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows on a 1536x1024 landscape PNG. One isolated fully visible object in each cell, generous transparent margins, no overlap, grounded bottom center. EXACT row-major contents:
Row1: (1) broad oak tree with rounded leafy crown and visible warm twisted trunk; (2) tall layered evergreen pine; (3) moss-covered grey stone cluster; (4) stone-and-timber academy cottage with steep teal-blue tiled roof, central arched wooden door, gold-star teal banner above door, THREE warm orange glowing windows: one in upper central gable and two small arched lower side windows. Academy faces almost straight front, symmetry, complete roof and front steps.
Row2: (1) rustic wooden FOOTBRIDGE crossing horizontally left-to-right, side railings along top and bottom edges and teal gold-star banner attached to lower railing, NO WATER beneath; (2) small turquoise rune monolith with glowing spiral on stone base; (3) low cluster of yellow, cream and tiny purple meadow wildflowers; (4) mossy fallen grey rubble barrier.
Row3: (1) cattails and reeds clump with no water; (2) low leafy fern; (3) small cluster of lily pads with one pale blossom, no water surface; (4) single grey riverbank rock with moss and a little grass on top.
Genuine alpha ZERO in all empty areas and cell gaps. No colored/white/grey backdrop, no checkerboard, ground plates, terrain tiles, text, labels, borders or UI. Natural tiny contact shading only within object silhouette. Keep subjects separated and entirely inside own cell. Match the supplied reference's warm painterly look rather than faceted low-poly geometry.
grass:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless game ground texture for CodeMap valley.
Create ONE square 1024x1024 opaque raster texture, straight top-down orthographic view, seamlessly tileable on all four edges. Warm painterly storybook RPG meadow matching a sunlit fantasy valley: small layered grass blades and soft olive/emerald greens with restrained golden yellow highlights, hand-painted brush texture, calm low contrast, suitable beneath tiny characters and UI. Dense living grass but broad gentle variation only; no single focal point. Uniform lighting, no cast tree shadows, vignette, baked sunbeams or directional gradients across whole image. NO paths, soil trails, trees, rocks, flowers, water, buildings, props, characters, border or text. Equal visual density right to the tile edges, opposite edges join naturally. Texture only, no scene or perspective horizon.
water:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: water surface ANIMATION TEXTURE ATLAS for a painterly 2D fantasy RPG.
Create a square opaque 1024x1024 image containing EXACTLY FOUR square frames in a strict TWO by TWO layout, each cell 512x512, no padding or lines between frames. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right = animation frames 1,2,3,4.
Each frame is a top-down water-only surface texture: rich turquoise and teal shallow clean river, delicate creamy pale-cyan looping ripples, flowing brush-stroke currents, a few tiny warm gold sun glints. Hand-painted storybook HD-2D style, natural soft texture, NO photorealism. Seamlessly tileable within each 512x512 frame: same colors/pattern densities across opposite edges. No large focal swirls or bright repeating symbols.
Animation must be coherent: the same fine ripples gently shift and morph a little downstream in each successive cell, with cyclic final-to-first continuity. Same average color and brightness across ALL four frames, no flashing or palette changes. Vertical downstream flow top to bottom. Each cell is a full water surface; NO banks, rocks, foliage, creatures, ground, horizon, scene, UI, text, gridlines, borders, shadows or perspective camera. This will fill a masked river and pond in-game.
foam:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 4-frame STREAM CASCADE / WHITEWATER sprite sheet for CodeMap painterly fantasy valley.
Square 1024x1024 PNG, EXACT TWO by TWO equal-cell grid, four separate sprites with generous alpha padding. Each sprite is the same tiny shallow stream waterfall viewed from elevated front/top RPG camera, running from screen-top toward screen-bottom: horizontal ragged crest of white foam, short turquoise falling water curtain, soft frothy bottom splash. Broad low drop, approximately twice as wide as tall, not a tall cliff waterfall. Delicate hand-painted creamy white/cyan water, thin translucent falling streaks, small gold sun glints. No rocks, banks, foliage, landscape, pedestal, floor, ground shadow, text or lines. ONLY water-and-foam effect, isolated with true alpha ZERO in empty regions.
Four consecutive looping animation frames in reading order; same footprint, size and baseline, but foam and falling streaks visibly progress downward and morph naturally; frame4 leads back into frame1. Transparent gaps between droplets, soft antialiased edges, identical palette/brightness in every frame, no flashing. Matching warm painterly HD-2D storybook game art, never photorealistic. Exact four separate cascades, centered one per cell.
